name: aws-deployment-intelligence
description: Dependency-aware change impact engine for AWS infrastructure

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:demo: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infrastructure/demo/baseline.yaml --stack-name adi-demo --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --region ap-south-1
scripts.deploy:platform: npm run build --workspace @adi/engine && cd infrastructure/platform && sam deploy
